desc: It’s a landmark event. America is turning 250 years old, and Federal Ammunition has partnered with legendary U.S. gun manufacturer Henry Repeating Arms to honor the milestone. As part of the collaboration, Henry is introducing a 250th anniversary edition of its iconic Golden Boy lever-action rifle, chambered in the classic 45-70 Govt. cartridge. Federal is providing the ammunition to keep that levergun running strong with this special-edition load. In addition to collectible packaging, it features reliable Federal brass and primers, as well as accurate jacketed soft-point bullets great for the range or hunting.
